label: Online shop (physical or digital products)
default_stack: Static storefront with product pages and structured data on GitHub Pages; checkout through Stripe Payment Links, Shopify Starter or Gumroad, chosen by the owner; inventory and orders as CSV in the repository.

questions.ask: What are the first three products, and where do they come from (make, wholesale, print on demand, digital)?
questions.default: Three products from the idea, sourced print-on-demand or digital so there is no stock to buy.

questions.ask: What does each product cost you, landed, and what do you want to sell it for?
questions.default: Agent builds a margin sheet in finance/ from supplier list prices and marketplace fees, with sources.

questions.ask: Own site only, or also Etsy, Amazon, eBay?
questions.default: Own site first; marketplace listings drafted for the owner to post.

questions.ask: Where will you ship, and who pays shipping?
questions.default: Domestic only, flat rate, built into the price.

questions.ask: Which country will the business be registered in (sales tax / VAT)?
questions.default: United States; the agent lists the sales-tax registrations your volume would trigger.

questions.ask: How many hours a week can you give it (packing, approvals, sign-ups)?

owner_setup.what: Decide whether to trade as yourself or register a company.
owner_setup.why: Liability and tax; an agent cannot sign registration forms.

owner_setup.what: Create the checkout account (Stripe, Shopify or Gumroad) and add its key or link where SETUP.md says.
owner_setup.why: Takes money into your account; needs your identity.

owner_setup.what: Register for sales tax / VAT where the finance checklist says you must.
owner_setup.why: A government registration in your name.

owner_setup.what: Open a separate business bank account.
owner_setup.why: Keeps the books clean; needs your ID.

owner_setup.what: Open the supplier or print-on-demand account the product plan names.
